tool.desc: By shaking the stick rapidly, you can make it glow in bright green colour.

tool.name: Shell snatcher
tool.desc: The perfect tool for snatching shells. It vibrates when shells are nearby.

tool.name: Dull machete
tool.desc: The blade is in no good condition, as if entire forests have already been cleared with it.

tool.name: Seth's swamp compass
tool.desc: The compass always points towards the center of the swamp, a necessity for any self-respecting adventurer.

tool.name: Sharp machete
tool.desc: Its razor sharp blade turns navigating through dense foliage into a walk in the park.

tool.name: Small sack
tool.desc: A small jute sack you can carry with you that can hold an extra item.

tool.name: Ink pen
tool.desc: This is what you want to use when signing important documents. Don't forget to read the fine print!

tool.name: Makeup set
tool.desc: Many Erdwiss merchants never leave their homes without a light application of makeup.

tool.name: Lil stool
tool.desc: A handy wooden stool for when you need to reach the top shelves.

tool.name: Bug attracting incense
tool.desc: This green incense stick is popular amongst local entomologists.

tool.name: Bug repelling incense
tool.desc: This red incense stick smells of eucalyptus, which is said to repel insects.

tool.name: Catch bucket
tool.desc: A decently sized bucket used for putting freshly caught fishing finds into.

tool.name: Big basket
tool.desc: Beautifully crafted from wicker. Can hold all your foraging finds with ease.

tool.name: Camo face paint
tool.desc: Camouflage paints that should be less irritating when used on the face. You are bound to get it in your eyes, since it is hard to see.

tool.name: Duck decoy
tool.desc: A fake duck that helps distract your prey from your presence. They probably just don't want to be rude.

tool.name: Flashy field knife
tool.desc: A great field knife that seems to be successful at whatever tasks you set it to during your hunting trips.

tool.name: Hunting bestiary
tool.desc: A grand tome of beasts, critters, and strange creatures of all kinds. Invaluable pages fill the book with illustrations, descriptions, habits, and habitats.

tool.name: Scent masking spray
tool.desc: A bottled liquid that can be sprayed and help mask your scent. We don't ask what the liquid is.

tool.name: Skinny field knife
tool.desc: A thin knife that could be using for skinning and cleaning a recent hunt.

tool.name: Rusty hunting bow
tool.desc: A once great metal bow, now rusted over. It still can be used for hunting, but not as well as it used to.

tool.name: Log basket
tool.desc: A wooden platform with a handle to carry it. Perfect for carrying some logs in, but also suitable for other items. Like another log basket.

tool.name: Bamboo hunting bow
tool.desc: A hunting bow made from bamboo, widespread in areas where bamboo is readily available. It's very light and makes for a precise hunting tool.

tool.name: Birch hunting bow
tool.desc: A hunting bow made from basic but workable birch wood.

tool.name: Oak hunting bow
tool.desc: A hunting bow made from oak, a popular choice among hunters.

tool.name: Spectral hunting bow
tool.desc: A few bones fashioned together into a hunting bow, its string a strand of ectoplasm that spirits away arrows to wherever you aim.

tool.name: Bright camo face paint
tool.desc: The face paint colours have been improved to be longer lasting and work in even more diverse environments. Sure hope it has been animal tested.

tool.name: Mangrove basket
tool.desc: The mangrove basket was built from two different baskets, but the mangrove planks hide the seams flawlessly.

tool.name: Fireflies in a jar
tool.desc: A very creative and natural way to light your way. They don't have a command word to turn off.

tool.name: Hand lantern
tool.desc: Hopefully you brought extra matches, because if the candle goes out while you're deep in the caves, you're done for.

pet.name: Camel
pet.desc: A sturdy camel, perfect for desert travels.
pet.rareDesc: Regular camels come with just a hump, but what a rare treat! This camel has <c>twice as many</c>!

egg.name: Camel egg
egg.desc: The egg left behind by a camel, you can tell because it has a hump on it. That's how you tell, right?

pet.name: Mummy
pet.desc: An unruffled mummy, may look dressed in rags, but knows all best ways to make them last.
pet.rareDesc: This mummy is adorned in some fine <c>silk</c>! It seems to be extremely fashionable for its age.

egg.name: Mummy egg
egg.desc: A mummy's egg. It may be covered in bandages, but you should still try to keep it warm. Wonder where the mother is?

pet.name: Pet Rock
pet.desc: It's a rock. You feeling alright? Gonna talk to it? Have fun.
pet.rareDesc: It is <c>pet rocks all the way down</c>. Maybe you're even a pet rock.

egg.name: Pet rock egg
egg.desc: A pet rock egg? Is this a joke? You think something is going to come out of this? It is just a bunch of rocks clumped together.

pet.name: Pixie
pet.desc: A hyped up pixie, or is it a fairy? Quite ready for the party of a lifetime. You better be ready for anything.
pet.rareDesc: There's a saying that if you run across a party pixie, you better plan to not do anything the next day. Will you survive?

egg.name: Pixie egg
egg.desc: A pixie egg. Don't shake it at all or jolt it around! That goes without saying normally, but these cause problems for everyone around when that happens.

pet.name: Reindeer
pet.desc: A cheerful reindeer, can prance through snowy places with ease and still have energy to spare.
pet.rareDesc: This reindeer is showing some spirit and is extra <c>festive</c>! It looks like it could fly, but you probably shouldn't test it.

egg.name: Reindeer egg
egg.desc: A reindeer's egg. Should get this warmed up more even though the fur coating helps keep it a little warmer.

pet.name: Tiger
pet.desc: A powerful tiger, boasting strength, stealth, and speed all in one.
pet.rareDesc: A <c>golden</c> tiger! You should feel quite lucky to be in good graces of one such as this.

egg.name: Tiger egg
egg.desc: The egg from a tiger. You would think it would have stripes on it too, but you'll have to hatch it for those.

pet.name: Tortoise
pet.desc: A reserved tortoise, just holding steady. Slowly, but steadily.
pet.rareDesc: The shell of this tortoise has the shine of <c>precious metals in the shape of a flower</c>!

egg.name: Tortoise egg
egg.desc: A tortoise egg. It has an extra hard shell to it. Guess it will never be without one.

consumable.name: Dried fruit
consumable.desc: A mix of different fruits that have been dehydrated to keep from spoiling. They still taste quite good!

consumable.name: Beer
consumable.desc: Fermentation may have been a greater discovery than fire.

consumable.name: Roasted bell pepper
consumable.desc: Charred and seasoned peppers, bursting with smoky flavor.

consumable.name: Jerky
consumable.desc: A big strip of cured, dried meat. Makes for a good source of protein on a long trip that won't spoil easily.

head.name: Candlehat
head.desc: It's a hat with a candle attached. What more could one desire?

secondary.name: Gem shield
secondary.desc: A fantastically lightweight shield inlaid with dazzling gems that give off a glowing light.

hands.name: Angler gloves
hands.desc: They do exist! Legendary gloves with glowing fingertips, drawing in all sorts of catches with their allure.

head.name: Mining helmet
head.desc: The mining helmet, a beacon in the depths of the earth, radiates a steady glow that pierces the darkness of subterranean realms.

secondary.name: Gem shield
secondary.desc: A fantastically lightweight shield inlaid with dazzling gems that give off a glowing light.

hands.name: Angler gloves
hands.desc: They do exist! Legendary gloves with glowing fingertips, drawing in all sorts of catches with their allure.

head.name: Candlehat
head.desc: It's a hat with a candle attached. What more could one desire?

secondary.name: Gem shield
secondary.desc: A fantastically lightweight shield inlaid with dazzling gems that give off a glowing light.

ring1.name: Gold sun stone ring
ring1.desc: This larger sun stone seems to infuse the gold with the light of the sun, glowing even in the darkest of places.
